overview: Today's bpf-next submissions featured a verifier bug fix and a build system overhaul. Eduard Zingerman submitted a two-patch series fixing incorrect null inference in check_cond_jmp_op(), a subtle verifier defect that could lead to unsound register state tracking. Mykola Lysenko posted v6 of a nine-patch series restructuring the selftests/bpf Makefile into a layered build, improving parallelism and build clarity.

patches.title: bpf: check_cond_jmp_op(): properly infer if register is null
patches.author: Eduard Zingerman
patches.summary: Fixes a bug in the BPF verifier's check_cond_jmp_op() where null inference for registers was performed incorrectly under certain conditional jump patterns. The verifier could incorrectly mark a register as non-null, leading to unsound state tracking and potentially allowing unsafe memory accesses to pass verification. This is a correctness fix in a critical verifier path that ensures conditional jumps produce accurate register liveness and nullness conclusions. The patch is accompanied by a companion selftest that reproduces the erroneous behavior.

patches.title: selftests/bpf: a demo for check_cond_jmp_op() non-null inference bug
patches.author: Eduard Zingerman
patches.summary: Adds a selftest that reproduces the null inference bug in the BPF verifier's check_cond_jmp_op() fixed by the companion kernel patch. The test constructs a BPF program that exercises the conditional jump path where the verifier previously made incorrect non-null assumptions about registers. It serves as both a regression guard and documentation of the precise scenario triggering the bug.

patches.title: selftests/bpf: keep headers off the generic link command line
patches.author: Mykola Lysenko
patches.summary: First patch of a nine-patch v6 series restructuring the selftests/bpf Makefile as a layered build system. This patch removes header files from the generic linker command line as a prerequisite cleanup for the broader refactor. The full series introduces Makefile.buildvars for shared build definitions, extracts BPF skeleton generation into a helper script, and runs each test runner instance in its own sub-make to improve build parallelism and correctness.
